description: Free. Checks a website's robots.txt rules for AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot), llms.txt, schema.org JSON-LD, title and meta description, content in raw HTML, and sitemap. Returns a 0 to 100 score and grade, plus a link to unlock the checks and prioritized fixes for $2.99.
